purpose: Teach: かから/そうして/背筋/座ら/変えれ/ぼろ/ふら/きょう

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、お金がかからない暮らしを大切にされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when Grandpa was young, he treasured a simple life — one that didn't cost much.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze. Voice carries the weight of memory. Slow, deliberate pace. Each phrase lands gently, like he's holding something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、そうしてお祖父ちゃん、お孫さんと過ごされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and Grandpa spent so much time with the grandchildren because of that, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, nodding recall. Gentle upswing at the end, inviting confirmation. Knowing tone, like she's savoring the memory alongside him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃんの背筋、まっすぐだったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when Grandpa was young, his posture was always perfectly straight.
lines.style: Admiring, almost reverent. Voice slows on 'straight' — lingering on the image. Quiet respect underneath, the kind that comes from witnessing something good.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、座らないで畑仕事をなさったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa never sat idle — he was always out working the fields, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. Not boasting, just stating fact with love underneath. Soft lilt upward at the end, affectionate and sure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんが暮らしを変えれば楽になるとおっしゃった
lines.en: Gran, Father used to say that if we changed how we lived, life would become easier.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly uncertain. Voice carries the echo of an old disagreement. Pause before the final phrase — acknowledging without judgment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんのお洋服、いつもぼろぼろになるまで大切になさったわね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa's clothes would wear through completely before he'd replace them, because he cherished what he had, didn't he?
lines.style: Tender, specific. Voice brightens on 'cherished' — celebrating the memory. Slight emphasis on the worn fabrics, like touching something beloved and weathered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、ふらふら旅されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when Grandpa was young, he used to wander — traveling here and there without much direction.
lines.style: Dreamy, loose. Voice unspools gently, following the path of old journeys. Light, almost whimsical — not lost, just free.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、きょうのこと、覚えていらしたわね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa remembered those days so clearly — he'd hold onto them, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Intimate, close whisper. Voice softens further, drawing the listener in. Knowing, like she's speaking a secret they share. Trailing affection at the end.
